g.text: Every imported kernel, memset and memcpy interval is shown. Memory operations share a lane; any overlapping intervals remain overlaid.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172b4d

g.text: Uncovered time is the complement of the union of GPU activity intervals; it does not identify a CPU or synchronization cause.

g.text: Fused kernels remain indivisible. Trace timings are instrumented diagnostics, not end-to-end benchmarks.
